posts.author: Paradajz
posts.body:
Hey Game Makers!
​
I am working on my first "serious" project, and I’m looking for a handful of testers to try out an
alpha build
.
As this is my first game (and not a small one), I want to collect some feedback for further development.
If you want  to be a tester please  write me a PM or  reply to this post.
i am looking for:
-Honest feedback to story and gameplay
-suggestions on improvement
-bug reporting.
-performance report
The content is about 10 hours so far.
Realmbreaker - Awakening
Paradajz - itch.io
Gameplay:
Classic old-school RPG with modern twists.
Choices that impact the story.
Turn-based combat (ATB system).
Open overworld exploration.
Rich side content and hidden secrets.
Age rating 16+ as it contains strong language and gore.
Spoiler:
Story
In the world of Edenai, two ancient gods, Aurora and Gorgon, created humanity and divided them into two tribes: the Lirian Empire in the east and the Kingdom of Agram in the west. After the gods vanished and 1,000 years of isolation, the Lirians attack Agram, wielding powerful technology stolen from the knowledge left behind by the gods. The Lirian onslaught devastates Agram, leaving the protagonists with a desperate mission: to recover an ancient artifact from his home village that holds the key to turning the tide of war.
Spoiler:
Characters
Sit
: After losing his mother, Sit left his hometown in search of purpose and eventually joined the army. He is driven by a strong sense of justice and determination to protect those he cares about, even as he struggles with the burdens of war and responsibility.
Shadis
: A steadfast guardian of her home village, Shadis has taken on the responsibility of protecting her people. Her deep sense of duty and connection to her roots make her a formidable ally. Serving as the voice of reason in the group, she provides wisdom and guidance during their journey.
Rufus
: Known for his love of hand-to-hand combat, Rufus is the son of Agram’s esteemed Commander and Sit's best friend. Despite his father’s honorable reputation, Rufus has a knack for getting into trouble and maintains covert ties to the underground world. His rebellious nature and fierce loyalty make him a key member of the team.
have fun!

Hi! Thank you, I am going to get to it right away, I will keep you posted for my review here in this post
@Paradajz
,
I reviewed your game for the Festival
Spoiler:
My review
Realmbreaker - Awakening
Realmbreaker - Awakening portrays a simple generic RPG premise where the world is a war torn world which was previously safeguarded and regulated by its creators. For now, the prospect of the story revolves around the tension of the Empire of Lirian in the East and the Kingdom of Agram in the West. The game begins with a harrowing massacre of the fortress where Sit and Rufus were stationed to defend.
The brutality of the event is underscored by the vivid imagery and the urgency of their flight. This massacre immediately invests players emotionally, rooting the narrative in themes of loss, survival, and resistance. After Sit was beaten to comatose by their pursuer, Rufus somehow unleased a strong power which completely instantly overwhelmed their pursuer. Waking up in Luka, Sit went to the Old Spot with Shadis and talked down their memory lane. They then both agreed to retrieve the artifact, known as Void Stone, to use it to end the war and  restore peace. Maverik later bequeathed a Summon named Nintail to Sit so that Sit and Shadis would survive and succeed in their mission.
The game follows the mechanic of learn skill system through equipments, found in Final Fantasy 9, and if I remember correctly, similiar magic materia system like in Final Fantasy 7 and similar  summon system in Final Fantasy 8. The mapping is creatively spaciously designed as if it was designed by an interior designer and civil engineer, and not just like jammed pack of collection of trees and houses in one location.
It has a working isometric front view map with shifting zooming sprite's perspective, nice implementation of isometric top down map on world map, properly accurate sound effects like the critters and stepping shoes on the ground in the background, and the battlers add to the art direction that is aesthetically inviting The game also portrays a natively acquainted English voice acting that adds even deeper depth into the game. Things that could be improved and added: quest log, and name of location, and more NPC's to complement the spacious design of the level design. I had to stop playing at about 1 hour, because of maybe some glitch, where I entered the cabin forest to look for Rufus, but ran into a red-crystal glitch in the top west of the map, where my party is stuck and the option of saving and resting kept on showing regardless of what I selected. Overall, I enjoyed the game, and it easily scored 7/10, pretty good for an Alpha. Carry on, mate.

Thanks i fixed that passable tiles.  I had them all right one time, but the famous "this tileset has incomplete flag data" bug  messed it up again and i had to rearange A LOT of tilesets. This one flew under my radar
​
​
Saving crystals: I´m still deciding between having a window or not. Which option do you prefer?
​
​
​
The combat:   yes i use afterimage for this particular skill Imput attack (not thundershock)  so that is intended and should only be while using the skill.
​
​
fixed flashing windows at opening scene.
​
​
As for the juming part:   I've modified the system so that pressing a direction is required to jump 3 tiles; otherwise, the character jumps in place.
​
​
But i'm afraid I don't quite understand your concern about "jump skipping on off cliffs."
​
This feature is intentional  (if the passable tiles are set correct
).
​
In fact, many maps are designed with alternative paths and hidden locations accessible through jumping.  For example there is a hidden chest with loot  after you exit the cave at the begining,
​
you need to jump a few times over the river/cliffs to get to it.
​
​
​
Thank you very much for your feedback so far!
​
